title: 7.4E: The Other Trigonometric Functions (Exercises)
originalText:
For the following exercises, find the exact value of the given expression.

39. \(\cos \frac{\pi}{6}\)

40. \(\tan \frac{\pi}{4}\)

41. \(\csc \frac{\pi}{3}\)

42. \(\sec \frac{\pi}{4}\)

For the following exercises, use reference angles to evaluate the given expression.

43. \(\sec \frac{11 \pi}{3}\)

44. \(\sec 315^{\circ}\)

45. If \(\sec (t)=-2.5,\) what is the \(\sec (-t) ?\)

46. If \(\tan (t)=-0.6,\) what is the \(\tan (-t) ?\)

47. If \(\tan (t)=\frac{1}{3},\) find \(\tan (t-\pi)\)

48. If \(\cos (t)=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2},\) find \(\sin (t+2 \pi) .\) There are two possible solutions.

49. Which trigonometric functions are even?

50. Which trigonometric functions are odd?
